title: SARS-CoV-2 Whole Genome Amplicon Sequencing from Wastewater
author: Vikram Chan-Herur
materials: Chemagic for the Viral DNA/RNA 300 Kit H96
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Carefully remove and discard the ethanol.
The remaining RNA is reverse transcribed into cDNA with the NEB LunaScript RT SuperMix then cleaned up and split in preparation for the two ARTIC PCRs.

SARS-CoV-2 cDNA is amplified in two reactions using the ARTIC 5.3.2 primers (15 nM each primer in the PCR) and NEB Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix then combined and cleaned up. Include at least one well on each plate as a negative control for the ARTIC PCR.

steps.title: Clarify Influent Sample
steps.instruction: Spin down 50 mL of influent at 5,250 xg for 5 min to clarify the influent.

steps.title: Prepare Nanotrap Sample Plates
steps.instruction: Distribute clarified influent and reagents into two KingFisher 24 Well Deep Well Plates.

substeps.instruction: Add 4.875 mL of influent sample to one well of the first KingFisher 24 Well Deep Well Plate.
Add 4.875 mL of influent sample to the same well location on a second KingFisher 24 Well Deep Well Plate.
Add 50 µL of Nanotrap Enhancement Reagent 1 (ER1) Solution to each well used.
Add 75 µL of Nanotrap Microbiome A Particles to each well used on both plates.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Plate
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL of MagMAX Microbiome Lysis Solution to each well of a new KingFisher 24 Well Deep Well Plate.

steps.title: Concentrate Viral Particles
steps.instruction: Run the KF-008-WW-Nanotrap-24.bdz protocol on the King Fisher Flex to concentrate viral particles into the Lysis Plate.

steps.title: Extract Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Perform automated nucleic acid extraction using the Chemagic 360 instrument and Viral DNA/RNA 300 Kit H96.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 300 µL of lysate from the Lysis Plate to each well of the Chemagic Deepwell Plate.
Add 300 µL of Lysis Buffer to each well.
Add 10 µL of Proteinase K to each well.
Add 60 µL of Elution Buffer to each well of an Elution Plate.
Set up, load, and run the Chemagic instrument.

steps.title: Remove PCR Inhibitors
steps.instruction: Purify the extracted nucleic acid using the Zymo OneStep PCR Inhibitor Removal Kit.

substeps.instruction: Mount a Zymo Silicon-A-HRC plate onto an Elution Plate.
Pierce the cover foil in the middle with a pipette tip and add 150 µL Prep Solution to the wells.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Centrifuge the plate at 3,500 xg for 5 min.
Transfer 60 µL of eluate from the Chemagic Elution Plate into the wells of the prepared Silicon-A-HRC Plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 3,500 x g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Digest DNA with Turbo DNase
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the total nucleic acid solution using Turbo DNase.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 40 µL of nucleic acid into a new plate.
Add 1 µL Turbo DNase and 4 µL 10X Turbo DNase Buffer to each sample.
Incubate in a thermal cycler: 37°C for 30 min, then hold (Lid Temp = 47°C, Total Volume = 45 μL).

steps.title: Clean and Concentrate RNA
steps.instruction: Clean up the digested RNA using KAPA HyperPure SPRI beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 90 µL Kapa HyperPure Beads to each well and mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place plate on a magnet until the liquid is clear.
While on the magnet, add 200 µL of 80% ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds.
Repeat the 80% ethanol wash (200 µL, 30 seconds).
Carefully remove and discard all residual ethanol.
Dry beads at room temperature for 3-5 minutes until ethanol has evaporated.
Remove plate from magnet and resuspend beads in 13 µL of elution buffer.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place plate on a magnet until the liquid is clear.
Transfer 11 µL of clear supernatant to a new plate for reverse transcription.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from the purified RNA using LunaScript RT SuperMix.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.75 µL LunaScript RT SuperMix to each well containing RNA.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate in a thermal cycler: 25°C for 10 min, 50°C for 50 min, 85°C for 5 min, then hold (Lid Temp = 95°C, Total Volume = 14 μL).

steps.title: Clean cDNA with SPRI Beads
steps.instruction: Purify the cDNA using KAPA HyperPure SPRI beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 27.5 µL Kapa HyperPure Beads to each well and mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place plate on a magnet until the liquid is clear.
While on the magnet, perform two washes with 200 µL of 80% ethanol (30 seconds each).
Carefully remove and discard all residual ethanol.
Dry beads at room temperature for 3-5 minutes.
Remove plate from magnet and resuspend beads in 12 µL of elution buffer.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place plate on a magnet until the liquid is clear.
Transfer 5 µL of clear supernatant to two new plates for ARTIC PCRs.

steps.title: Perform ARTIC PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the viral genome using ARTIC Pool A and Pool B primers.

substeps.instruction: Prepare two master mixes (Pool A and Pool B). Per sample: 6.25 µL Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix and 1.25 µL of ARTIC PCR primer pool working stock (150 nM).
Add 7.5 µL of Pool A master mix to the first plate (5 µL cDNA) and 7.5 µL of Pool B master mix to the second plate (5 µL cDNA).
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate in a thermal cycler: 98°C for 30 sec, then cycles of 35°C for 95 sec (incorrect in text, likely 95°C for 15 sec) and 63°C for 5 min, then hold.

steps.title: Clean and Pool PCR Products
steps.instruction: Combine and purify the ARTIC PCR products using KAPA HyperPure SPRI beads.

substeps.instruction: Combine 12.5 µL of Pool A and 12.5 µL of Pool B reactions (total 25 µL).
Add 20 µL Kapa HyperPure Beads, mix 10 times, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on magnet until clear.
Perform two washes with 200 µL of 80% ethanol (30 seconds each).
Discard ethanol and dry beads for 3-5 minutes.
Remove from magnet and resuspend beads in 27 µL of elution buffer.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place on magnet until clear and transfer 25 µL of clear supernatant to a new plate.

steps.title: End Preparation
steps.instruction: Perform end repair, 5' phosphorylation, and dA-tailing using NEBNext Ultra II DNA Library Prep Kit.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 µL NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix and 3.5 µL NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer to each well.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate in a thermal cycler: 20°C for 30 min, then 65°C for 30 min, then hold.

steps.title: Adapter Ligation and USER Enzyme Treatment
steps.instruction: Ligate adapters and excise uracil using the USER enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.25 µL NEBNext Adaptor for Illumina to each well (do not premix with Master Mix).
Add 15 µL NEBNext Ultra II Ligation Master Mix to each well.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate in a thermal cycler: 20°C for 15 min, then hold (Lid Temp = 30°C, Total Volume = 47 μL).
Add 1.5 µL USER Enzyme to each well and mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate in a thermal cycler: 37°C for 15 min, then hold (Lid Temp = 47°C, Total Volume = 48 μL).

steps.title: Clean Ligation Products
steps.instruction: Remove enzymes and salts using KAPA HyperPure SPRI beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 43 µL Kapa HyperPure Beads, mix 10 times, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on magnet until clear.
Perform two washes with 200 µL of 80% ethanol (30 seconds each).
Discard ethanol and dry beads for 3-5 minutes.
Remove from magnet and resuspend beads in 12 µL of elution buffer.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place on magnet until clear and transfer 10 µL of clear supernatant to a new plate.

steps.title: Indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Add dual-indexed primers via PCR to enable multiplexing.

substeps.instruction: Add 12.5 µL Q5 NEBNext Library PCR Master Mix and 2.5 µL Index Primer Mix to each well.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate in a thermal cycler: 98°C for 30 sec, 98°C for 10 sec, 65°C for 75 sec, 65°C for 5 min, then hold (Lid Temp = 105°C, Total Volume = 25 μL).

steps.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform final purification of the indexed libraries using KAPA HyperPure SPRI beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 22.5 µL Kapa HyperPure Beads, mix 10 times, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on magnet until clear.
Perform two washes with 200 µL of 80% ethanol (30 seconds each).
Discard ethanol and dry beads for 3-5 minutes.
Remove from magnet and resuspend beads in 27 µL of elution buffer.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place on magnet until clear and transfer 25 µL of clear supernatant to a new plate.

steps.title: Library Quantification and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Quantify, pool, and sequence the final libraries.

substeps.instruction: Measure library concentration by qPCR using the KAPA Illumina Library Quantification kit.
Pool samples aiming for equimolar amounts.
Sequence the pool on an Illumina system using a kit that yields ≥250PE reads.
